description_en: Creates an Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance
kebab_example: aliyun vpc create-global-acceleration-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-location china-mainland --bandwidth 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateGlobalAccelerationInstance

parameters.help_en:
The region where the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance resides. 

You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
全球加速实例所在的地域。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The area where the accelerated service resides. Valid values:

china-mainland: the Chinese mainland.

north-america: North America.
   
asia-pacific: Asia-Pacific.
   
europe: Europe
parameters.help_zh:
被加速的服务的所属区域，取值：

china-mainland：中国内地。

north-america：北美。
   
asia-pacific：亚太。
   
europe：欧洲
parameters.name: service_location

parameters.help_en: The peak bandwidth of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Unit: Mbit/s. Valid value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例的带宽峰值，单位为Mbps，取值：10
parameters.name: bandwidth

parameters.help_en:
The bandwidth type of the instance. Valid values:

Sharing: shared bandwidth.

Exclusive: dedicated bandwidth
parameters.help_zh:
实例带宽类型，取值：

Sharing：带宽共享型。

Exclusive：带宽独享型
parameters.name: bandwidth_type

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance.  

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-), but cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
全球加速实例的名称。  

长度为2~128个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字、点号（.）、下划线（_）和短横线（-），但不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. 

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character, but cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
全球加速实例的描述信息。 

长度为2~256个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，但不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. 

The client generates the value of this parameter. Ensure that the value is unique among different requests. The value can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
客户端token，用于保证请求的幂等性。 

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。
parameters.name: client_token

GlobalAccelerationInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance

IpAddress.description_en:
The public IP address of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance.

If BandwidthType is set to Sharing, this parameter is not returned
IpAddress.description_zh:
全球加速实例的公网IP地址。

如果BandwidthType取值为Sharing，则不返回该参数
